responsibility: This file implements deserialization helpers for GCC's generic LTO/streamer layer. It reads indexed and null-terminated strings from the shared string table, decodes variable-length signed and unsigned integers, poly_int values, gcov counters, and physical wide_int/widest_int representations from lto_input_block or bitpack streams, and performs range/overrun validation. It is the low-level input side of GCC's typed bytecode streaming support.
